text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin Bakushiiin! Come, let us give it 
our all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A class rep is very busy, so days like 
this happen! I made sure to attend all my 
supplementary lessons!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, starting our training at 
this hour isn't necessarily a bad thing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, you can use the track wide 
open! You can run at full power without 
worrying about those around you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words! It is the ideal 
environment to Bakushin at maximum speed!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Easier to Bakushin at max speed... Easier 
to... go straight at max speed?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I feel the potential...! A potential that 
could even lead to "top speed"...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, I'm heading out now too. I 
feel like I'll achieve even greater 
results than usual!
choice_data_list: Let's ride Sakura Bakushin O's momentum!

I can't allow side-by-side training while 
you're this fatigued.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Feel free to study a Class Rep's 
exemplary running style up close to your 
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's go! Bakushin, bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A direct objection! ...Yet, it's a 
completely sound argument that I cannot 
dispute.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Pushing yourself when you're 
tired only leads to injury. Let's do this 
together another time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be safe, we decided to wrap up training 
early.
